title: Criminal Law Special Provisions Extension to Quetta Municipality and Cantonment Act Repeal Ordinance 1973

sections.shortTitle: Criminal Law Special Provisions Extension to Quetta Municipality and Cantonment Act Repeal Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE I OF 1973
ORDINANCE I OF
1973
CRIMINAL LAW (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) (EXTENSION TO QUETTA
MUNICIPALITY AND CANTONMENT) ACT (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1973
Art Ordinance to repeal the
Criminal Law (Special Provisions) (Extension to Ouetta Municipality and
Cantonment) Act, 1972
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 3rd March 1973]
No. Legis. 1-14/Law/71, (A).---The
following Ordinance by the Governor of Baluchistan is hereby published for
general information-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Criminal Law (Special
Provisions) (Extension. to Quetta Municipality and Cantonment) Act (Repeal)
Ordinance, 1973.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
